comparisons.comparison: Both NVDA and AMD report the composition of their 'All Other' operating losses for fiscal year 2024, specifically attributing significant portions to stock-based compensation. NVDA attributes a decrease in loss to the absence of a prior year acquisition charge, while its 2024 loss was partially offset by an $839 million increase in stock-based compensation. AMD’s All Other operating loss of $4.2 billion in 2024 consisted of $1.4 billion in stock-based compensation expense, alongside $2.4 billion in amortization of acquisition-related intangibles.
